name: @v18/sdk-web
description: V18 web kit: the widget, the verify libraries and the demo site (release scripts only)

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix verify-node && npm run build --prefix widget && npm run build --prefix demo-site
scripts.test: npm test --prefix verify-node && npm test --prefix widget && npm test --prefix demo-site && python -m pytest verify-python/tests -q && npm run test:scripts
